shared_elements: carved stone monument in upright/vertical format
motifs stacked in horizontal zones or registers
suggestion of human form (figures in A, anthropomorphic mass in B)
justification: Both are upright stone monuments bearing shallow relief organised into stacked horizontal zones, and both include disc/circle elements and long curving bands, which is the most concrete correspondence. But A is a thin, flat, smoothly dressed slab with crisply cut, tightly ordered figural and script-like registers, whereas B is a massive rounded three-dimensional block whose eroded, sparse, curvilinear motifs follow the swelling body of the sculpture rather than a ruled layout.
